issue_context.title: Namespace with multiple identifiers in name does not end up in output
issue_context.body:
### Describe the bug

Create a namespace with multiple identifiers (technically nested namespaces) and it will not end up in the emitted output.

### Input code

```typescript
namespace Test.Test {
  export const Value = 1;
}

console.log(Test.Test.Value);
```


### Config

_No response_

